meta.note: Values are checked against src/styles.css by `npm run design:tokens:check`; usage notes and type styles are maintained here.

tokens.name: durion-blue-800
tokens.usage: Blueprint Blue, deepest. Light-theme top header (`navBackground`) and the deep end of the landing hero band. Raw palette: reach it through a Tier-3 token in components.

tokens.name: durion-blue-700
tokens.usage: Blueprint Blue, the brand blue. `brand-primary`: primary buttons, the light-theme nav rail, the start of the hero band. As text it is a light-theme colour only (1.3:1 on the dark card).

tokens.name: durion-blue-600
tokens.usage: Blueprint Blue. Light-theme sub-menu fill and the info functional colour.

tokens.name: durion-blue-500
tokens.usage: Blueprint Blue. Light-theme focus border on fields (`input-focus-border`) and `primaryA300`.

tokens.name: durion-blue-400
tokens.usage: Blueprint Blue. Dark-theme `primaryA400` and focus border. Only 3.4:1 on the dark card, so never link or body text.

tokens.name: durion-blue-300
tokens.usage: Blueprint Blue. Dark-theme `primaryA300`.

tokens.name: durion-blue-200
tokens.usage: Blueprint Blue, light. Dark-theme link text (`link-color`): 6.3:1 on the dark card, 9.1:1 on the dark page.

tokens.name: durion-blue-100
tokens.usage: Blueprint Blue wash. Light-theme selected/hover fill (`primaryA100`), user chat bubble, and subdued text on the hero band (`on-brand-band`).

tokens.name: durion-blue-50
tokens.usage: Blueprint Blue, palest. `brand-primary-soft` and the light-theme tonal button fill (`primary50`).

tokens.name: durion-graphite-800
tokens.usage: Graphite, deepest. Dark-theme field fill (`input-background`), sub-menu and popover surface.

tokens.name: durion-graphite-700
tokens.usage: Graphite. `brand-secondary`; dark-theme decorative border. As text it fails on the dark card (1.3:1): use `text-muted`.

tokens.name: durion-graphite-600
tokens.usage: Graphite. Light-theme muted text and placeholder (`handleColor`): 6.2:1 on white.

tokens.name: durion-graphite-500
tokens.usage: Graphite. Light-theme field and control outline (`input-border`): 4.4:1 on a white field. Fails 4.5:1 as small text.

tokens.name: durion-graphite-400
tokens.usage: Graphite. Dark-theme field outline: 3.7:1 on the field fill, 3.6:1 on the card.

tokens.name: durion-graphite-200
tokens.usage: Graphite, light. Light-theme decorative border and scrollbar track; dark-theme muted text (7.9:1 on the dark card).

tokens.name: durion-graphite-100
tokens.usage: Graphite, palest. Light-theme system chat bubble.

tokens.name: durion-teal-600
tokens.usage: Electric Teal. Light-theme accent for icons and borders (`accentA400`). UI only, never in the logo.

tokens.name: durion-teal-500
tokens.usage: Electric Teal. A filled accent (with `on-accent-fill` text, 6.1:1).

tokens.name: durion-teal-400
tokens.usage: Electric Teal, the identity teal (`brand-accent`): borders, icons, small fills. White text on it is 2.4:1, so a teal button with white text uses `accent-strong` instead.

tokens.name: durion-teal-300
tokens.usage: Electric Teal, light. Dark-theme accent for icons and borders (`accentA400`).

tokens.name: durion-teal-200
tokens.usage: Electric Teal tint. Decorative washes only.

tokens.name: durion-teal-100
tokens.usage: Electric Teal wash. Light-theme accent background (`accentA100`).

tokens.name: durion-gold-600
tokens.usage: Heritage Gold, darkest. Light-theme gold text and icons (`goldA400`): 4.6:1 on white. Dark-theme gold wash.

tokens.name: durion-gold-500
tokens.usage: Heritage Gold, canonical: sampled from the logo shield border. Fills and borders only (fails as text on white). Never write the hex literally in component CSS; use `brand-gold` or `goldA400`.

tokens.name: durion-gold-400
tokens.usage: Heritage Gold. Fills and borders.

tokens.name: durion-gold-300
tokens.usage: Heritage Gold, light. Dark-theme gold text and icons (`goldA400`): 6.3:1 on the dark card.

tokens.name: durion-gold-200
tokens.usage: Heritage Gold tint. Fills.

tokens.name: durion-gold-100
tokens.usage: Heritage Gold wash. Light-theme gold background (`goldA100`).

tokens.name: durion-grey-900
tokens.usage: Neutral, near-black. Light-theme body text, dark-theme top header, and the label on a filled teal (`on-accent-fill`).

tokens.name: durion-grey-800
tokens.usage: Neutral. Dark-theme page background (`themeBackground`).

tokens.name: durion-grey-700
tokens.usage: Neutral. Dark-theme card surface (`cardBackground`) and scrollbar track.

tokens.name: durion-grey-500
tokens.usage: Neutral mid-grey. Not used for text.

tokens.name: durion-grey-100
tokens.usage: Neutral, off-white. Light-theme page background (`brand-background`, `themeBackground`).

tokens.name: functional-error-red
tokens.usage: Error fill, border and icon. Also AA as text on white (6.5:1). White text on it (critical alert, danger button) is 6.5:1.

tokens.name: functional-warning
tokens.usage: Warning fill, border and icon. Fails as text: warning text is `status-warning-fg`.

tokens.name: functional-info-blue
tokens.usage: Info border and icon (same value as blue-600).

tokens.name: functional-success
tokens.usage: Success border and icon. Use `status-success-fg` for success text on a tint.

tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: Primary actions and the brand surface: primary button fill, light nav rail. A fill colour: link text uses `link-color`.

tokens.name: brand-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Subtle primary tone behind brand content.

tokens.name: brand-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary fill. Never as text on a surface (1.3:1 on the dark card).

tokens.name: brand-accent
tokens.usage: UI accent: borders, icons, small fills. Never carries white text (2.4:1); text on it is `on-accent-fill`.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Filled teal button or CTA with white text: 6.4:1. The only teal that takes white text.

tokens.name: accent-strong-deep
tokens.usage: Deep end of the accent gradient and the accent button's hover: white text 9.3:1.

tokens.name: logo-plate
tokens.usage: The white plate behind the logo mark, in both themes. Part of the mark, not a surface; the only sanctioned always-white fill.

tokens.name: on-brand-band
tokens.usage: Subdued text on the fixed blue-700 to blue-800 landing band, in both themes: 6.7:1 on blue-700, 10.5:1 on blue-800.

tokens.name: on-accent-fill
tokens.usage: Label on a filled `brand-accent` (teal-400/500), in both themes: 7.9:1 on teal-400, 6.1:1 on teal-500.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Heritage and premium accent, not the UI accent. Fills and borders; gold text uses `goldA400`.

tokens.name: brand-background
tokens.usage: Light page background.

tokens.name: brand-surface
tokens.usage: Light card and dialog surface.

tokens.name: themeBackground
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards. The app shell's content area.

tokens.name: navBackground
tokens.usage: Top header bar (56px). Text on it is `contrastTextColor`.

tokens.name: menuBackground
tokens.usage: Left nav rail. Items are white at 75% (hover and active: `contrastTextColor`).

tokens.name: subMenuBackground
tokens.usage: Nested nav group fill.

tokens.name: cardBackground
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, table wraps.

tokens.name: currentTextColor
tokens.usage: Body text on `cardBackground`, `themeBackground` and `surface-variant`: 18.7:1 / 16.8:1 light, 9.3:1 / 13.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: contrastTextColor
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills: primary and accent-strong buttons, header, nav rail, error-red fills.

tokens.name: primaryA400
tokens.usage: Primary marks: focus outlines on rows, drop-target outline, selected borders. Not text in dark (3.4:1).

tokens.name: primaryA300
tokens.usage: Secondary primary marks.

tokens.name: primaryA100
tokens.usage: Selected and hover fill: listbox option, primary status chip, chips. Text on it is `currentTextColor`.

tokens.name: primary50
tokens.usage: Tonal (secondary) button fill; text on it is `link-color`.

tokens.name: accentA400
tokens.usage: Accent icons and borders; focus outline on the dark header.

tokens.name: accentA700
tokens.usage: Strong accent marks (focused ledger field underline).

tokens.name: accentA100
tokens.usage: Accent wash behind body text. Dark value is the source's color-mix(teal-600 45%, cardBackground), resolved: body text on it 5.9:1.

tokens.name: goldA400
tokens.usage: Heritage gold text and icons: 4.6:1 on white, 6.3:1 on the dark card.

tokens.name: goldA100
tokens.usage: Heritage gold wash.

tokens.name: trackColor
tokens.usage: Scrollbar track.

tokens.name: handleColor
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb and the muted-text source: 6.2:1 on white, 7.9:1 on the dark card.

tokens.name: border-color
tokens.usage: Decorative border: card and table outlines, dividers, dropdown edge. Below 3:1 on purpose, so never a control's only boundary.

tokens.name: input-background
tokens.usage: Form field fill, native option list.

tokens.name: input-border
tokens.usage: Field and control outline (WCAG 1.4.11): 4.4:1 on the light field, 3.7:1 on the dark field. Also outline buttons and dropzones.

tokens.name: input-focus-border
tokens.usage: Focus border on fields, plus a 3px halo of itself at 20%; keyboard-active listbox option outline.

tokens.name: input-placeholder-color
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in fields (AA in both themes).

tokens.name: chat-bubble-user-bg
tokens.usage: User message bubble in the assistant panel.

tokens.name: chat-bubble-system-bg
tokens.usage: Assistant message bubble.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: Elevated surfaces: dropdowns, popovers, menus.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Secondary elevated surface.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash over a row or item on any surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, metadata, table headers: 6.2:1 on white, 7.9:1 on the dark card. The only way to mute text; never opacity.

tokens.name: link-color
tokens.usage: Link and interactive text on a surface; tonal button label. 8.7:1 on white, 6.3:1 on the dark card.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Inset well inside a card: filter bars, toolbars, zebra rows, notices. The source's color-mix(border-color 45%, cardBackground), resolved.

tokens.name: skeleton-bg
tokens.usage: Loading-placeholder fill. The source's color-mix(border-color 70%, cardBackground), resolved.

tokens.name: status-error-bg
tokens.usage: Error chip, badge, alert and banner fill. Always paired with `status-error-fg`.

tokens.name: status-error-fg
tokens.usage: Error text and icon on `status-error-bg`: 5.6:1 light, 7.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning chip, badge, alert and banner fill. Always paired with `status-warning-fg`.

tokens.name: status-warning-fg
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon on `status-warning-bg`: 5.2:1 light, 8.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: status-success-bg
tokens.usage: Success chip, badge, alert and banner fill. Always paired with `status-success-fg`.

tokens.name: status-success-fg
tokens.usage: Success text and icon on `status-success-bg`: 6.9:1 light, 7.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: status-info-bg
tokens.usage: Info chip, badge, alert and banner fill. Always paired with `status-info-fg`.

tokens.name: status-info-fg
tokens.usage: Info text and icon on `status-info-bg`: 5.7:1 light, 7.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: status-ready-bg
tokens.usage: Ready chip, badge, alert and banner fill. Always paired with `status-ready-fg`.

tokens.name: status-ready-fg
tokens.usage: Ready text and icon on `status-ready-bg`: 6.4:1 light, 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: status-neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Neutral chip, badge, alert and banner fill. Always paired with `status-neutral-fg`.

tokens.name: status-neutral-fg
tokens.usage: Neutral text and icon on `status-neutral-bg`: 8.4:1 light, 8.0:1 dark.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Landing hero headline on the blue band. Title Case is reserved for this marketing surface.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The page h1 in `.page-header`. One per page. Weight is `font-weight-display`.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: h2 for a page section, a state panel or a dialog. Weight is `font-weight-heading`.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card and row titles (h3), the shell brand name.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a title or a form section legend, in `text-muted`. Set text-transform: uppercase; the copy itself stays sentence case.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Closing payroll for Sept 1 to Sept 14 is final. Its time entries can no longer be approved or changed.
styles.usage: Default running text. The root size is 16px.

styles.name: field
styles.sample: Search by customer, invoice #, or workorder #
styles.usage: Text inside inputs, selects and textareas.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Positivity brings your customers, workorders, billing and team together.
styles.usage: Dense UI text: alerts, table cells, hints, standfirsts in tight layouts.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels. Sentence case, verb first.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form field labels above the control.

styles.name: table-header
styles.usage: Data table column headers, uppercase, in `text-muted`.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a list item, field hints in dense rows.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Identifiers, SKUs, codes and log output, in `text-muted` beside a name.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 4px. Icon-to-label gap, chip vertical rhythm, label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 8px. Field padding (block), chip padding (inline), gaps inside a control group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 12px. Field padding (inline), alert and table-cell padding (block), gaps between actions.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 16px. Card padding, button padding (inline), table-cell padding (inline), gaps between fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: 20px. Fills the 4 to 6 gap: roomy button padding, a card's inline padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 24px. Dialog padding, gap between form sections, page-header bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: 32px. State-panel padding, gap between page regions and side columns.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, fields, selects, square tags, dropdown panels, alerts, scrollbar thumb (3px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, notices and toast-like outcome bars.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large containers: table wraps, state panels, dashboard cards.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Card lift (`.dur-elevation-2`). The other elevation steps are fixed shadows on `.dur-elevation-1`, `-3` and `-4` in src/styles.css.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: Header bar and nav rail edge.

fontWeight.note: Barlow Semi Condensed is hosted at 500, 600 and 700 only; any other weight on --font-primary synthesises a faux bold and is banned.

tokens.name: font-weight-display
tokens.usage: h1, page titles, strong display emphasis.

tokens.name: font-weight-heading
tokens.usage: h2 to h4, card titles, overlines, labels, chips, buttons.

tokens.name: font-weight-medium
tokens.usage: Large or lighter display subheads where 600 is too heavy.
